methodology.end_to_end: Identical final Go harness on baseline commit and working tree. Two sequential alternating rounds, four warmups and eleven timed runs per version/query/source/worker count. Table loading and forced GC after loading are excluded; allocator holding table source remains alive. All outputs match independently executed DuckDB SQL. Timing comparisons use Exec only; collection/release are separately recorded.
methodology.sources: Parquet versus retained table read from the same file; tables have 4096-row scan batches while Parquet uses row-group tasks. These runs isolate repeated decoding, but task granularity and source memory also differ.
methodology.query: id >= rows/4, group by day or category, SUM(id), order by the group key ASC NULLS LAST
methodology.microbenchmarks: 32768 randomized rows, PCG(91,37), 1024-row batches, key domains 16/4096/32768, numeric/inline-string/long-string keys, nullable keys and values, dense or bitmap-selected one-in-eight inputs. General baseline uses existing general state; dispatch uses production constructor. SUM and COUNT outputs checked in each iteration. Three 150ms samples per case. State bytes are charged estimates, not RSS.
methodology.memory: Separate seven-run release/stream/four-retained-result passes at one/four workers, normal build, original million-row file. Heap allocation samples exclude forced GC. Used measures live segment capacity; total slab capacity is reusable storage, not RSS/peak query payload.
methodology.profiles: 150 timed executions at one worker after 12 warmups; source loading and initial preparation/warmup excluded. CPU profiles contain substantial runtime.madvise and file syscall samples; treat application stacks as diagnostic evidence and use unprofiled timings/microbenchmarks for speedup claims.
methodology.limitations: Local workloads, not an official benchmark suite. String-key/multi-key/distinct/AVG/MIN/MAX group plans retain general implementation; improvements apply to one fixed-width key with numeric SUM and/or COUNT. Native amd64 runtime remains unverified here.
